question.title: Average Salaries by Department and Job
question.desc: Find the average salary for each department and job title. Sort the results by department and then by job title.
question.setup: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS employees; CREATE TABLE employees (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), department VARCHAR(255), job_title VARCHAR(255), salary DECIMAL(10, 2)); INSERT INTO employees (name, department, job_title, salary) VALUES ('John Doe', 'Sales', 'Salesman', 50000.00), ('Jane Doe', 'Marketing', 'Marketing Manager', 70000.00), ('Bob Smith', 'Sales', 'Salesman', 60000.00), ('Alice Johnson', 'Marketing', 'Marketing Manager', 80000.00), ('Mike Brown', 'IT', 'Developer', 90000.00);
question.solution: SELECT department, job_title, AVG(salary) AS average_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department, job_title ORDER BY department, job_title;
question.tips: Consider using indexes on the department and job_title columns for larger datasets.
hints: You will need to use the AVG function to calculate the average salary.
Use the GROUP BY clause to group the results by department and job title.
The ORDER BY clause will be used to sort the results by department and then by job title.
